name: imbalance fade
selection_rule: a push of >=1.5% within 2h that ends >=0.5% above the prior-day value-area high, then gives back >=50% of the push within 4h
note: Price pushed up 1.9% in 1h50m to 87,385, 7.8% above the prior-day value-area high (81,080), then gave back 68% of the push within 2h20m.

name: swing top
selection_rule: daily: >=3 consecutive up days, then a day closing in its lower third with the high above the prior 10 days; relaxed by 25% once
note: RELAXED threshold (-/+25%): 2+ up days in a row, then 19 Sep: new 10-day high (81,934) but the day closed at 81,226, in the lower 37% of its range (weak close after a run-up).

name: counter trade in balance
selection_rule: UTC day with range <60% of the median range of the prior 20 days, high and low both inside the prior-day value area
note: 26 Sep range was 709 USD = 36% of the 20-day median range (1,954); high and low both stayed inside the prior-day value area (83,500-84,490): a quiet, balanced day.

name: limit sell below the last volume step
selection_rule: daily: inside day right under a 20-day high after >=5 up days of the last 10
note: 22 Sep is an inside day (range 85,080-86,700 sits inside 21 Sep) right under the 20-day high (87,385), after 7 up days out of the last 10.

name: trend continuation pullback
selection_rule: day with close-open >=+1.5%; after 06:00 UTC price touched the UTC-day VWAP, stayed within 0.2% for >=3 5m bars, then made a new day high
note: Day closed +6.7% (open to close). After 06:00 UTC price touched the UTC-day VWAP (81,475) at 07:10, stayed within 0.20% of it for 3+ bars, then made a new day high (82,222) at 08:20.

name: breakout
selection_rule: >=6h with 5m range <0.8%, then a 5m close above the range high with 5m volume >=2x the balance median
note: 24.0 h+ (look-back capped at 24 h) of balance (5m range 83,750-84,297, 0.65%), then a 5m close at 84,309 above the range with volume 10.0x the balance median.

name: VWAP scalp
selection_rule: day with range <1.2% where the 5m close crosses the UTC-day VWAP >=8 times
note: Day range only 0.85%; the 5m close crossed the UTC-day VWAP 33 times (pink dots).

name: gap close (CME-gap proxy)
selection_rule: Monday 00:00 UTC open vs Friday 21:00 UTC close differ by >=0.8% and the gap is closed within the Monday
note: Friday 21:00 UTC close 79,656 vs Monday 00:00 UTC open 80,301: weekend gap +0.81% (CME-gap proxy, OURS). Price came back to the Friday level at Mon 03:37 UTC on Monday: gap closed.

name: gap holds (CME-gap proxy)
selection_rule: same gap proxy, NOT closed within Monday and Monday closes further in the gap direction
note: Friday 21:00 UTC close 63,418 vs Monday 00:00 UTC open 65,702: weekend gap +3.60% (CME-gap proxy, OURS). Price never returned to the Friday level on Monday and Monday closed at 66,286, further in the gap direction.

name: closing-auction reversal
selection_rule: NO BTC equivalent (24/7 market, no closing auction)
note: no BTC equivalent

name: cross-market lead (crude oil vs index)
selection_rule: NO data on disk for crude oil / index
note: no BTC equivalent: no crude-oil or index data on disk

name: break-in
selection_rule: 5m close >=0.3% above the prior-day VAH, within 2h a 5m close back below VAH, then price reaches the prior-day POC within 4h
note: 5m close 84,613 was 0.35% above the prior-day value-area high (84,320); within 15 min a 5m close came back below it, and price then reached the prior-day POC (83,315) 105 min later.

name: news shock V reversal
selection_rule: day's largest 15-minute move >=2%, then >=60% retraced within 6h
note: Largest 15-minute move of 15 Sep: -2.27% (76,756 to 75,011, ending 18:49 UTC); 72% of it was retraced within 0.5 h (to 76,276).

name: candle formations at a range edge
selection_rule: three same-colour 1h candles ending at a 20-day high or low
note: 3 green 1h candles in a row ending at a new 20-day high (87,385; previous 20-day high 86,874), 21 Sep 20:00 UTC.

name: top after forced buying
selection_rule: hour with volume >=4x the 30-day hourly median at a 30-day high, then a 5m close below that hour low within 6h
note: The 15:00 UTC hour on 21 Sep printed a 30-day high (86,340) with volume 4.2x the 30-day hourly median; in the first 5m bar after that hour ended a 5m close (85,722) fell below the hour's low (85,750).

name: low-volume-node scalp
selection_rule: price enters the prior-day profile's lowest-volume 50-USD band inside the value area and the next 15 min travel >=0.3%
note: Prior-day profile's thinnest 50-USD band inside its value area is 83,700-83,750. Price entered it at 17:58 UTC and travelled 0.33% up in the next 15 minutes (thin zone = little trading there before).

name: balance with CVD pressure, break on volume
selection_rule: >=6h with 5m range <1% while the CVD proxy moves (near-)monotonically >=1.5x its 30-day 6h median move, then first 5m close outside in the CVD direction with volume >=2x balance median
note: 24.0 h+ (look-back capped at 24 h) balance (5m range 79,348-79,966, 0.78%) while the CVD proxy climbed steadily (83% of half-hour steps in one direction, net +1,583 BTC = 1.6x the 30-day 6h median), then the first 5m close above the balance at 80,065 with volume 6.5x the balance median.

name: absorbed push
selection_rule: 15-min window with |delta proxy| in the top 2% but price change in the bottom 30%, then >=0.5% move against the delta sign within 2h; relaxed by 25% once
note: RELAXED threshold (-/+25%): 15-min window 02:45 UTC: aggressive buying (delta proxy +1,277 BTC, top 2.5% of the last 120 days) but price moved only 0.02% (bottom 38%). Within 2h price then moved 0.58% the other way.

name: failed breakout back into balance
selection_rule: 5m close >=0.2% outside the prior-day value area, back inside within 30 min, then reaches the opposite edge within 6h
note: 5m close 80,758 was 0.2%+ below the prior-day value-area low (80,960); 25 min later it was back inside, and 2h00m after that price reached the opposite edge (81,480).

name: buyers protect a level
selection_rule: touch of prior-day VAL within 0.1% with negative 15-min delta proxy, low holds, then +0.7% within 2h
note: 15-min bar 22:30 UTC touched the prior-day value-area low (84,070, low 84,025) with a negative delta proxy (-125 BTC: sellers aggressive) yet the low held, and price rose 0.70% within 2 h.

name: IVB first 30 minutes of the US open
selection_rule: weekday 13:30-14:00 UTC range, then a 5m close outside it
note: First 30 minutes of the US open (13:30-14:00 UTC) ranged 83,434-84,306 (1.05%). The first 5m close outside it was 14:00 UTC at 83,210 (below).

name: volume-defined fair value gap
selection_rule: last swing A->B >=2% within 3 days, fixed-range 1m profile A->B, lowest-volume 50-USD band inside its value area, price returns to it
note: Swing up 82,832 -> 85,224 (2.9% in 26h, A 24 Sep 09:00, B 25 Sep 11:00). Fixed-range 1m profile A->B: 70% value area 83,790-84,840, thinnest 50-USD band inside it 83,850-83,900. Price returned to that band at 25 Sep 12:17 UTC (next 2 h shown).
